raw.query: SELECT image_px, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ratio_meas_over_aic IS NOT NULL AND is_valid=true) AS valid_ratios, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_valid=true) AS valid_rows, MIN(ratio_meas_over_aic) FILTER (WHERE ratio_meas_over_aic IS NOT NULL AND is_valid=true) AS min_r, MAX(ratio_meas_over_aic) FILTER (WHERE ratio_meas_over_aic IS NOT NULL AND is_valid=true) AS max_r FROM collector_encoder_fn GROUP BY image_px ORDER BY image_px;
raw.observed: Of 7 resolutions in 224²-896², only 448² has ratio_meas_over_aic values (85 rows; min 1.2535, max 1.6208). 224², 320², 336², 640², 672², 896² each have 0 valid ratios (aic_pred_ms NULL on every non-aic row; engine='aic' rows are themselves the prediction).
raw.evidence: The two largest resolutions (672², 896²) and four of the five others have no AIC-vs-measurement comparison rows at all, so 'agreement within 15.5% at the two largest' and 'per-resolution ratios are archived' are unsupportable; the only resolution with any comparison data is 448².
